question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **emotions**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Emotions **refer to feelings and reactions that a person experiences in response to a particular situation or event. (भावनाएँ)
 
• The word "rumination" is used to describe this process.
 
• "**Rumination**" refers to the act of continuously thinking about the same thoughts or problems, often in a repetitive and unproductive manner. (चिंतन)
 
• So, the sentence is essentially saying that when people fear rejection, they may start thinking about these negative emotions over and over again, engaging in rumination.
 
• It's a common human tendency to ruminate on negative emotions, and it can be harmful to one's mental well-being.
 
• In the context of the sentence, the word "**emotions**" is the most suitable choice to complete the sentence because it specifies what kind of negative thoughts or feelings people might dwell on when they fear rejection.

• The word "**Endurance**" refers to the ability to withstand hardship or adversity. (सहनशीलता)
 
• "**Formalities**" refer to the conventional rules or procedures that need to be followed in a particular situation. (औपचारिकताओं)
 
• "**Stoppages**" refer to interruptions or halts in the progress of something. (ठहराव)
